game_title: Call Stack Tower – Northern Wall Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the innkeeper ahead. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the watch bell by solving code steps involving stack_height that move the innkeeper forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the watch bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Call Stack Tower' (Week 6 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Northern Wall'.
